messages:
jess: Heads-up — onboarding SSO sample using C# SDK failing: REST create route returns 201 but C# client returns 422. Error: "missing required field: model_variant". Anyone seen C# parity gaps vs REST?

akshay: can you paste the REST vs C# snippets? my guess: naming/shape mismatch (timeout vs TimeSpan) or SDK stripping unknowns.

jess: REST (works):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\
  -d '{"name":"team-sso","model":"gpt-open-3","model_variant":"v2","timeout":20}'
```
C# SDK (422):
```csharp
// using Redwood.SDK v2.0.1
var payload = new RouteCreate { Name = "team-sso", Model = "gpt-open-3", Timeout = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(20000) };
var res = await client.Routes.CreateAsync(payload);
// no ModelVariant property on RouteCreate and server rejects request
```

akshay: ah — RouteCreate in C# exposes Timeout as TimeSpan and serializes to "00:00:20" string. Backend expects numeric seconds. Also there's no ModelVariant on the DTO. That plus the serializer ignoring unknowns will drop model_variant.

pete: also saw a secondary issue: our internal HttpClient retry handler will re-send POSTs on transient 502s once. For this customer that led to duplicate route creation because upstream actually processed the request but returned 502.

jess: logs show two POSTs 1s apart and no Idempotency-Key header: 
```
[2026-02-12T08:01:01Z] POST /v1/routes req=r_x - upstream=502
[2026-02-12T08:01:02Z] POST /v1/routes req=r_y - created
```
Customer saw duplicate routes in the console.

akshay: short-term mitigation: construct the raw JSON matching REST and use client.SendRawAsync, or set an explicit Idempotency-Key and disable the retry handler for non-idempotent calls. Example:
```csharp
var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { name = "team-sso", model = "gpt-open-3", model_variant = "v2", timeout = 20 });
await client.Transport.PostJsonAsync("/v1/routes", json, headers: new { ["Idempotency-Key"] = Guid.NewGuid().ToString() });
```

pete: I'll add an ops rule to detect multiple route creations with identical payloads within a 3s window as a temporary alert.

aj: (typo) akshay — propose SDK fixes: 1) add ModelVariant property to RouteCreate DTO, 2) accept Timeout as int seconds or TimeSpan and normalize on serialize (prefer numeric seconds), 3) do not auto-retry POSTs by default unless Idempotency-Key is provided, 4) provide helper to set Idempotency-Key easily.

devex-bot: Created DEVEX-5055: "csharp-sdk: route create parity — add ModelVariant, normalize Timeout serialization, and restrict POST retries by default" https://tickets.redwood/DEVEX-5055 :robot_face:

jess: I'll attach the failing sample app, exact sdk version and server logs to DEVEX-5055. Also adding a tiny integration test that compares SDK JSON to canonical REST JSON for route create.

pete: will wire up the temporary alert and document the workaround in onboarding README.

aj: I'll take the SDK change — will add compatibility layer, unit tests, and a migration note.

jess: thanks all. leaving updates in the ticket. :thumbsup:
